Prague Bus Lines Check

Every Prague city bus line (PID 100–299) against the save game. The game check below lists every game line with its buses and stops against the PID timetable of 30 September 2026. It shows which lines have no vehicles, which serve other stops, and which PID lines are not built. Each line card then gives the timetable, the Simutrans schedule, the stops, and the buses that ran it on Friday 25 September (seznam-autobusu.cz deployment records) with their liveries and pak128 objects, for DPP and every other operator alike. Companion to the Prague tram and trolleybus sheets.

How this was built

  • Game. The save-game session exported every line of the save numbered 100100–100299 (PID licence numbers; the name's first six digits), with buses, schedule entries and halts. A game line is compared with the PID line of the same number. Variants (e.g. 100102K) are compared with the same PID line.
  • Stops. A game halt matches a PID stop when one of its names (the parts between “/”, without “Praha,” and the stand letter) equals the PID name. Abbreviated or misspelt names count as the same stop and are listed as names to fix. Layover stands (“odstav”) are skipped. The game's round trip is split at the PID termini and each half is compared with the busiest PID pattern of that direction: missing stops, extra stops, a stop in place of another, and order.
  • Timetable. PID GTFS (data.pid.cz/PID_GTFS.zip, export 2026-09-29), service date 20260930, routes whose licence number is 100100–100299 with route type 3 (bus); trolleybus 275 is on the trolleybus sheet. Main pattern = the busiest stop sequence per direction in 15:00–17:59. Buses needed = the larger of cycle_need (a bus leaving around 16:00 followed round the main round trip, at least 3 minutes at each terminus) and the most buses on the road at once in 16:00–17:00 over every pattern of the line (each trip plus its terminus layover: 3 minutes, or less where the timetable turns faster). The second decides on lines with branches and short workings, which the main round trip misses (191: 6 by round trip, 15 on the road).
  • Simutrans schedule. The shared rule in pipeline/README.md: the longest exact run of one Departure every / Offset / Also at pattern around 16:00, at most 8 departures per cycle; approximate fits give their largest deviation. Every bus terminus is a turn, so all values are 1 minute early, with the real minute printed under each. Other patterns with at least 3 peak trips are separate Simutrans lines.
  • Vehicles. seznam-autobusu.cz, vypravenost/pid/vypis per line for Friday 25 September, and for 21–24 and 29 September on lines not run by DPP or not logged on the 25th. Where the logged courses are fewer than the buses needed, courses logged on the nearest other day fill in, if that bus was not out anywhere in PID on the 25th (seznam-autobusu.cz day overview). Any still missing are designed, not recorded, with real buses. They come from the line's own history since 1 September (since January 2025 for lines with no September record), are active in the register, and were not out anywhere on the 25th. The picks first cover every bus type in the line's history that the logged buses lack, then take the most recent. The free history buses left over are listed dimmed as "not needed" and are not counted. Where the history has too few free buses, a free active bus of the line's type from its operator fills in. Each car is matched by its register id to type, garage, paint and year (all DPP buses and the registers of every PID city operator).
  • Liveries. PID grey-red, PID red-white-blue, DPP red-white, city red-white (Stenbus), Veolia red-grey, white, turquoise-yellow (Stenbus 1700) and the Fashion Arena wrap of Vega Tour's line 238 buses (kept as its own objects at the user's request), from the register's current paint. An advert wrap or another livery maps to the most common normal livery of the same operator, type and year (the pak session's rule).
  • Pak128. Object names follow the VZ pak session's scheme of 29 September: VZ-DPPraha-<type>-<livery>-<id> for DPP and VZ-Praha-<type>-<livery>-<id> for every other operator; articulated buses are -A + -B. Which objects exist is read from the pak checkout (VZ-DPPraha-bus: 9093ae8; VZ-Praha-bus: 9093ae8; VZ-Praha-water: 9093ae8).
  • Rebuilding. pipeline/praha-bus: python scripts/run.py --state 2026-09-29. The README there explains how to refresh the game export, the timetable and the vehicles.
